name: Podman out of Podman (poop)
description: Wires podman to the host's rootless podman socket (podman-outside-of-podman), parallel to docker-outside-of-docker. Mounts the host socket at /root/.poop/poop and exposes it as CONTAINER_HOST. The socket source defaults to ${localEnv:XDG_RUNTIME_DIR}/podman/podman.sock.
